headlines.title: PepsiCo just lost the KFC US business—here's how much it could sting financially
Jefferies Maintains Coca-Cola Buy Rating as KFC Switches US Beverage Supply From PepsiCo
headlines.summary: Jefferies has maintained its Buy rating on Coca-Cola (NYSE:KO) and Hold rating on PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) following KFC’s decision to replace Pepsi with Coca-Cola as its beverage supplier in the United States. The investment bank described the change as unexpected, particularly as it follows Marriott’s decision several months earlier to move to Coca-Cola after maintaining a relationship with Pepsi for approximately 30 years.

headlines.title: KFC Dumps Pepsi For Coke In US Restaurants Starting 2027 — PEP Stock Drops
headlines.summary: KFC said the transition to Coca-Cola products will begin in January 2027, with full availability expected across all U.S. locations by spring of that year.

headlines.title: KFC Is ditching Pepsi. Why It Fell Flat With Investors.
headlines.summary: Pepsi gets only a small part of its sales from KFC, but the loss still stings.

headlines.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Warns India Energy Drink Stocks Could Run Out Within Two Months
headlines.summary: PepsiCo (NasdaqGS:PEP) warns its energy drink portfolio in India could face stock outages within two months after a regulatory label ban. Indian authorities have barred PepsiCo energy drink labels that reference specific ingredient claims, while rivals such as Red Bull can keep selling. The restriction targets PepsiCo products in a category that management has highlighted as important within its broader India beverage push.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
